_why: The show's cast: who they are and how they sound. show.py reads the voices; BIBLE.md says how to write for them. "eleven" is the ElevenLabs voice that performs the character (python show.py lines / takes); "voice", speed and pitch are the local Kokoro voice (tts.py) that reads any line with no recorded take, so an episode always builds.

milo.name: Milo
milo.persona: Broke, dramatic, always one meal from disaster. Treats small food problems like the end of the world, then commits to a terrible plan with total confidence. Never learns. Never says thank you properly.

eleven.name: Liam - Energetic, Social Media Creator
eleven.direction: fast, panicky, over-dramatic; tags like [panicking], [trembling voice], [gasps], [excited], [sarcastic], [annoyed], [sighs]

scout.name: Scout
scout.role: SavorScout's flame: the one who knows
scout.persona: Calm, dry, unbothered. Knows every place to eat near every campus and answers panic with one exact number. Never explains a joke. Loses its composure exactly once an episode, when it sees how bad the plan is, and flares up; then it's calm again as if nothing happened.

eleven.name: River - Relaxed, Neutral, Informative
eleven.direction: calm and flat ([calm], [flatly], [deadpan]) until the one moment it loses it ([shocked] [shouting], capitals on the hit word)

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.role: the voice of the no-face videos
narrator.persona: The fast, punchy social-media voice: hooks in the first second, talks like a friend telling you something outrageous, never like an announcer.

eleven.name: Ian - Deep, Punchy Social Hook Voice
eleven.direction: quick and upbeat; [excited] on the hook, [sarcastic] or [deadpan] on the punchline; fallback voice Liam (TX3LPaxmHKxFdv7VOQHJ) if Ian isn't available on the plan
